title: Product Import Issues
description: Common product import problems and solutions, including CSV format errors, data validation issues, and import failures.
content:
Product Import Issues

This guide helps you troubleshoot common issues when importing products via CSV, including format errors, validation problems, and import failures.

CSV Format Errors

Common Issues

  • Invalid CSV format
  • Missing required columns
  • Incorrect data types
  • Encoding problems
  • Special character issues

Solutions

  • Use provided CSV template
  • Check column headers match exactly
  • Verify data types (text, numbers, dates)
  • Use UTF-8 encoding
  • Escape special characters
  • Remove hidden characters

Data Validation Errors

Problems

  • Missing required fields
  • Invalid data formats
  • Duplicate SKUs
  • Invalid categories
  • Price format errors

Solutions

  • Fill all required fields
  • Verify data formats
  • Ensure unique SKUs
  • Create categories before importing
  • Use correct price format (no currency symbols)
  • Validate data before importing

Image Import Issues

Problems

  • Images not importing
  • Invalid image URLs
  • Image size too large
  • Unsupported formats

Solutions

  • Use valid image URLs
  • Check image accessibility
  • Resize large images
  • Use supported formats (JPG, PNG, WebP)
  • Upload images separately if needed
  • Verify image URLs are accessible

Import Failures

Issues

  • Import process stops
  • Partial imports
  • Timeout errors
  • Server errors

Solutions

  • Split large files into smaller batches
  • Reduce file size
  • Check server timeout settings
  • Import during off-peak hours
  • Review error logs
  • Try importing in smaller chunks

Category Issues

Problems

  • Categories not found
  • Invalid category names
  • Category hierarchy issues

Solutions

  • Create categories before importing
  • Use exact category names
  • Check category slugs
  • Verify category hierarchy
  • Import categories first

Variant Import Issues

Problems

  • Variants not importing
  • Variant data errors
  • Attribute mismatches

Solutions

  • Use correct variant format
  • Define attributes before importing
  • Verify variant structure
  • Check attribute values
  • Review variant examples

Best Practices

  • Always backup before importing
  • Test with small file first
  • Validate CSV before importing
  • Use provided templates
  • Review import preview
  • Keep original files
  • Document custom formats

Preparing CSV Files

Tips for preparing CSV:

  • Use Excel or Google Sheets
  • Save as CSV UTF-8
  • Remove formulas
  • Check for hidden rows/columns
  • Validate data types
  • Test with sample data

Getting Help

If issues persist:

  • Review import documentation
  • Check CSV format guide
  • Use import template
  • Contact support with error details
  • Share sample CSV (remove sensitive data)
